bullets.text: Chennai residents and suburbs suffered prolonged power cuts on Sunday, and the office should monitor TNPDCL to ensure grid stability.
A car suddenly caught fire on a road near Velachery, causing panic, and police are currently investigating the accident.
Public protest and a road blockade occurred in Thiruvallur due to a power cut, and the office must watch power distribution issues.
A police officer rescued a young woman from being hit by a train in Thiruvallur, averting a tragic accident.
Avadi metro water board works on East Gopalapuram Road narrowed the street and inconvenienced motorists, requiring local coordination.
Tamil Nadu is witnessing new global capability centres expand and set up operations, which the portfolio team should actively support.
India's data centre sector saw a return to multi-city investment strategies in Chennai, indicating strong regional tech infrastructure growth.
Google is advancing its USD 15 billion AI data hub despite community scrutiny, and our office should monitor large tech investments.
Chief Minister Vijay requested Prime Minister Modi to reconsider Madurai and Coimbatore metro rail projects during an event.
Prime Minister Modi urged students to learn from Thirukkural and take Tamil culture everywhere during his address at IIT Chennai.
